        time.sleep(3)
        scanning = scan.IsScanning
print("Scanning finished")
del spm

import nanosurf
import time

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Contact mode (LateralForce) to minimize tip damage
print("Setting operating mode to Contact mode...")
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm image
print("Configuring scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # 0.4 seconds per line (51.2s / 128 lines)
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

print(f"Scan configured: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6}x{scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm, {scan.Points}x{scan.Lines} points, {scan.Scantime}s per line")
print(f"Total estimated scan time: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines} seconds")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Try to get the image path from gallery
try:
    gallery = application.Gallery
    if hasattr(gallery, 'GetLastImagePath'):
        image_path = gallery.GetLastImagePath()
        print(f"Image saved at: {image_path}")
    elif hasattr(gallery, 'LastImage'):
        last_image = gallery.LastImage
        if hasattr(last_image, 'Path'):
            image_path = last_image.Path
            print(f"Image saved at: {image_path}")
        elif hasattr(last_image, 'FileName'):
            image_path = last_image.FileName
            print(f"Image saved at: {image_path}")
    else:
        print("Gallery object available but path retrieval method not found")
        print(f"Gallery attributes: {dir(gallery)}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error accessing gallery: {e}")
    print("Attempting alternative method...")

del spm

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

print("Setting operating mode to Contact mode (LateralForce) to minimize tip damage...")
# Set to contact mode (LateralForce) which minimizes tip damage
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

print("Configuring scan parameters...")
# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm area
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # time per line in seconds (51.2s / 128 lines = 0.4s)

print(f"Scan configured: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6}x{scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm, {scan.Points}x{scan.Lines} points")
print(f"Time per line: {scan.Scantime}s, Total estimated time: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines}s")

# Start scan from bottom to top
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the saved image path
try:
    # Try to get the last saved image from the gallery
    gallery = application.Gallery
    if gallery.Count > 0:
        last_image = gallery.Item(gallery.Count - 1)
        image_path = last_image.FullName
        print(f"Image saved at: {image_path}")
    else:
        print("No images found in gallery")
        image_path = None
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error getting image path from gallery: {e}")
    image_path = None

del spm

if image_path:
    print(f"\nFinal image path: {image_path}")

print(f"Scan parameters set:")

print(f"  Resolution: {scan.Points} x {scan.Lines} points")
print(f"  Time per line: {scan.Scantime} s")
print(f"  Total scan time: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines} s")
print(f"  Operating mode: Contact (LateralForce)")

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

print("Setting operating mode to Contact mode (LateralForce) to minimize tip damage...")
# Set operating mode to Contact mode (LateralForce) which minimizes tip damage
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

print("Configuring scan parameters...")
# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm with 128x128 resolution
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # 0.4 seconds per line (51.2s / 128 lines = 0.4s)
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

print(f"Scan configured: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6}x{scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm, {scan.Points}x{scan.Lines} points, {scan.Scantime}s per line")
print(f"Total estimated scan time: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines} seconds")

print("Starting scan...")
# Start scan from bottom to top
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the last saved file path
try:
    # Try to get the file path from the application
    file_path = application.GetLastSavedFilePath()
    print(f"Image saved at: {file_path}")
except:
    print("Could not retrieve file path directly from application")
    file_path = None

del spm

import nanosurf
import time
import os
import glob

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Contact mode (LateralForce) to minimize tip damage
print("Setting operating mode to Contact mode...")
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

# Set scan parameters
print("Configuring scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # time per line in seconds (51.2s / 128 lines = 0.4s)

print(f"Scan configured: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6}x{scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm², {scan.Points}x{scan.Lines} points, {scan.Scantime}s per line")
print(f"Total scan time: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines} seconds")

# Get the workspace directory
workspace_dir = r'C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\corral\corral\tasks\afm\src\afm\claude-sonnet-4-5_subtask_2_ReAct\enviroment\subtasks_2'

# Get list of existing .nid files before scan
existing_files = set(glob.glob(os.path.join(workspace_dir, '**', '*.nid'), recursive=true))
print(f"Found {len(existing_files)} existing .nid files before scan")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Wait a moment for file to be saved
time.sleep(2)

# Find the newly created .nid file
new_files = set(glob.glob(os.path.join(workspace_dir, '**', '*.nid'), recursive=true))
image_files = new_files - existing_files

if image_files:
    image_path = list(image_files)[0]
    print(f"Image saved at: {image_path}")
else:
    print("Warning: Could not find newly created image file")
    image_path = None

del spm

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to LateralForce (Contact mode) for minimal tip damage
print("Setting operating mode to Contact mode (LateralForce)...")
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

# Set scan parameters
print("Configuring scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # 0.4 seconds per line (51.2s / 128 lines)
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

print(f"Scan parameters set:")
print(f"  Image size: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")
print(f"  Resolution: {scan.Points} x {scan.Lines} points")
print(f"  Time per line: {scan.Scantime} s")
print(f"  Total scan time: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines} s")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Try to get the saved file path
try:
    # Get the gallery history filename
    filename = application.GetGalleryHistoryFilename(0)  # 0 for the most recent image
    print(f"Image saved at: {filename}")
    image_path = filename
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Could not retrieve filename via GetGalleryHistoryFilename: {e}")
    # Try alternative method
    try:
        filename = application.GalleryHistoryFilename
        print(f"Image saved at: {filename}")
        image_path = filename
    except Exception as e2:
        print(f"Could not retrieve filename via GalleryHistoryFilename: {e2}")
        image_path = "Path retrieval failed"

del spm
print(f"\nFinal image path: {image_path}")

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Contact mode (LateralForce) to minimize tip damage
print("Setting operating mode to Contact mode...")
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

# Set scan parameters
print("Configuring scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # 0.4 seconds per line (51.2s / 128 lines)
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

# Set a specific filename for this scan
file_name = "scan_10x10um_"
application.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(file_name)

print(f"Scan configured: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6}x{scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm, {scan.Points}x{scan.Lines} points, {scan.Scantime}s per line")
print(f"Expected total scan time: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines} seconds")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the current parameters to confirm
print(f"Final scan parameters: Width={scan.ImageWidth*1e6}µm, Height={scan.ImageHeight*1e6}µm, Points={scan.Points}, Lines={scan.Lines}")

del spm

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Contact mode (LateralForce) to minimize tip damage
print("Setting operating mode to Contact mode...")
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

# Set scan parameters
print("Configuring scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # time per line in seconds (51.2s / 128 lines = 0.4s)

print(f"Scan configured: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6}x{scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm, {scan.Points}x{scan.Lines} points, {scan.Scantime}s per line")
print(f"Total scan time: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines}s")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished")

# Get the last saved file path
try:
    last_file = application.GetGalleryHistoryFilename(0)
    print(f"Image saved at: {last_file}")
    saved_path = last_file
except:
    print("Could not retrieve file path using GetGalleryHistoryFilename")
    saved_path = None

del spm

if saved_path:
    print(f"\nFinal path: {saved_path}")

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Contact mode (LateralForce) - minimizes tip damage
print("Setting operating mode to Contact mode...")
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm with 128x128 resolution
print("Configuring scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # seconds per line (51.2s / 128 lines = 0.4s)
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

print(f"Scan configured: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6}x{scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm, {scan.Points}x{scan.Lines} points, {scan.Scantime}s per line")
print(f"Total estimated scan time: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines} seconds")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Try to get the saved file path
try:
    # Check if there's a method to get the last saved file
    if hasattr(application, 'GetLastSavedFilePath'):
        file_path = application.GetLastSavedFilePath()
        print(f"Saved file path: {file_path}")
    elif hasattr(application, 'Gallery'):
        gallery = application.Gallery
        print(f"Gallery object: {gallery}")
        if hasattr(gallery, 'GetLastFile'):
            file_path = gallery.GetLastFile()
            print(f"Last file: {file_path}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error getting file path: {e}")

# List available methods and properties
print("\nExploring application object...")

print(f"Application attributes: {app_attrs[:20]}...")  # Print first 20

del spm

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Contact mode (LateralForce) to minimize tip damage
print("Setting operating mode to Contact mode...")
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm image
print("Configuring scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # 0.4 seconds per line (51.2s / 128 lines)
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

# Set a specific filename for easy identification
file_name = "scan_10x10um_"
application.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(file_name)

print("Starting scan...")
print(f"Scan parameters: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6}x{scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm, {scan.Points}x{scan.Lines} points, {scan.Scantime}s per line")
print(f"Expected total scan time: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines} seconds")

# Start scan from bottom to top
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Clean up
del spm

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Contact mode (LateralForce) to minimize tip damage
print("Setting operating mode to Contact mode...")
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² image
print("Configuring scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # seconds per line (51.2s / 128 lines = 0.4s)

print(f"Scan configured: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6}x{scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm², {scan.Points}x{scan.Lines} points, {scan.Scantime}s per line")
print(f"Total estimated scan time: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines} seconds")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Try to get the file path
try:
    file_path = application.GetGalleryHistoryFilename()
    print(f"Image saved at: {file_path}")
except:
    print("Could not retrieve file path using GetGalleryHistoryFilename")
    file_path = None

del spm
